abstract.para: Learn about automated system tuning, checking &saptune; status and applying &sap; workload solutions.

topic.para: When you install &productnameshort;, &saptune; is automatically installed and enabled. This tool is used to apply &suse; and &sap; best practices for OS-level tuning based on your specific &sap; workload.
